functions.purpose: Builds the UI value-objects for the NPC-friend ('ATD' companion) detail panel: for the currently selected NPC group it emits a _detail VO plus per-degree gift/lock lists. Reads the NPC-friend group record from the local player context (ctx+0x2ac0), fills GroupId/GroupName, current & max impression (friendship points), friendship degree tiers (unlock/selected flags, degree name strings) and the gift item list. Pure client-side VO population fed to a UI list widget (vtbl+0xf 'push VO').
formulas: player ctx obtained via (*(*(*(DAT_1202e818+0xd0)+0x90))+0xb4)() ; NPC-friend group record base = *(ctx+0x2ac0), skipped if null
MaxImpression = FUN_11730460(groupRec[2])  (max impression for the group's current stage)
CurImpression = min( groupRec_impression[1] , MaxImpression )  -> clamped so displayed current never exceeds max
GroupId = groupRec[0xb]; degree = groupRec[2] (current friendship tier/stage)
per-degree loop stride = 9 dwords (pppppuVar9 += 9); bUnLock = (degreeValue <= *(entry+8)); bSelected = (degreeValue == *(iVar3+8))
GroupName string resolved via FUN_100e5b40 record (+0x14); degreeName via FUN_117302b0(degree)->record+0x14
class names: NPC_ATD_VO_CLASS_NAME, NPC_FRIENDLOCK_VO_CLASS_NAME, NPC_DETAIL_VO_CLASS_NAME, TASK_AWARD_CLASS_NAME
costs: CurImpression / MaxImpression are the NPC-friend intimacy points shown to the player; server owns the accrual, client only clamps display
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI VO builder). Impression values, degree/tier unlock state and gift eligibility are server-authoritative; this only renders them. The min(cur,max) clamp is a display safeguard.
functions.notes: Emits fields: GroupId, GroupName, CurImpression, MaxImpression, degree, degreeName, bUnLock, degreeString, bSelected, degreddUnLockString, itemIconPathName, ItemID, IsUnLock, bloodType, bodyHeight, weight, profession, homeTown, description. bloodType/bodyHeight/weight/profession/homeTown/description gated by FUN_11509f90(*,idx) presence checks (idx 1..7). Gift item list read from group[5]..group[6] stride 4.

functions.purpose: Command handler (dispatch mode param_6==2) that builds the full quest/task detail VO for the selected task: award item list (task_awardList), selectable-award list (task_selectawardList), quest meta (taskName/taskLevel/taskid/tasktype/cantGiveup/queststatus/bTeam/bRepeat/bTrace), currency & progression reward previews, and the target-tracking sub-VO (TASK_TARGET_VO_NAME with up to 5 targets). Reward amounts are computed client-side by scaling quest-config base values by the player's hunt-rank/count factor.
formulas: selected award index resolved from param_5: if (*(param_5+4)&0x8f) in {3,4} -> awardId=*(param_5+8) else 0xdeadbeaf (sentinel = no selection)
reward scaling pattern (repeated): value = (int)( (float)*(cfgRec + off) * (float)factor ) where factor = result of CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(...) passed through FUN_1185f2e0()
field DAT_11dbfbc8 (exp/points-type reward) = (float)*(rec+8) * (float)huntFactor ; only when unaff_EBX[0x13] != 0
field DAT_11dc0944 (gold reward) = (float)*(rec+8) * (float)factor ; gold_bind = (float)*(rec+0xc) * (float)factor2  (two separate hunt-rank counts feed bound vs unbound gold)
farm_actuarialpoint = (float)*(rec+8) * (float)factor
hunter_contribution = cfg16c[1]; hunter_fund = cfg16c[3]; hunter_exp = cfg16c[2]  (guild-task rewards, read directly from config record FUN_108049c0)
huntingCredit = *(FUN_10804d10(rec+0x13)+4); npcfriendvalue = *(FUN_10804a00()+8)
queststatus/limit: FUN_10804c90() row, status flag = (rowCount >= 2) ? 1 : 0

task target VO stride = 0x3b dwords per target; fields: nTargetID1..5 = t[0..4], nOpType=t[5], nCurCount=t[6], nMaxCount=t[7], strTarget1..5 = t[0xd],t[0x13],t[0x19],t[0x1f],t[0x25], nQuestType=t[0x38], DAT_11dca838=t[0x39]; special-case when t[0x3a]==3 && t[0x34]!=4
taskid = task[1]; tasktype = task[4]; cantGiveup = *(byte)(task+7); bShare = *(byte)((task)+0x81); autotrak = *(byte)(cfg+0x11); shoqwCurQuestLevel = *(byte)(cfg+0x45)
costs: gold reward (DAT_11dc0944) and gold_bind (bound gold) = base * huntRankFactor
hunter_contribution / hunter_fund / hunter_exp = guild-task contribution, guild fund and guild exp rewards, read from task config offsets [1],[3],[2]
huntingCredit, npcfriendvalue, farm_actuarialpoint = additional currency/point rewards scaled by hunt-rank factor
functions.serverRelevance: validation/client-preview. These formulas are the client's reward PREVIEW; the server must own actual grant of gold/bound-gold/exp/contribution/fund and enforce the same base*huntRankFactor scaling. cantGiveup/bTeam/bRepeat are server-enforced quest rules the client mirrors.
functions.notes: calls CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount (confirmed). Reward multiplier factor comes from GetHuntRankOrCount output normalized by FUN_1185f2e0. hunter_contribution/hunter_fund/hunter_exp confirm this task type feeds the guild (hunter-group) economy. Config accessors: FUN_10804cd0(0x19), FUN_10804940(0x18), FUN_10804980, FUN_108049c0(0x21), FUN_10804d10(0x24), FUN_10804a00 index the quest reward config table.

functions.purpose: Builds the NPC-organization (faction) list VO. Iterates the player's NPC-org records (from ctx+0x2ac0 group container) and for each emits OrgID, OrgName, current org friend/reputation value, the max for the current stage, the stage index, and the next-level unlock description string. Also caches the first org's id into a global (current-selected org).
formulas: org record iterated; OrgID = orgRec[3][5]; on first record (iStack_98==0) global DAT_123bb9a4 = orgRec[3][5] (current org id)
NpcAtdInGroupsStage = orgRec[2]  (current reputation stage/level)
OrgFriendValue = orgRec[1]  (current reputation points)
OrgFriendValueMax = FUN_1172eac0(orgRec[2])  (max reputation for current stage)
NextLevelUnLockContent = FUN_1172eb20(stage+1) string  (unlock description for next stage)
costs: OrgFriendValue / OrgFriendValueMax = faction reputation points and the per-stage cap (FUN_1172eac0 maps stage -> cap)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (VO builder). Faction reputation accrual and stage progression are server-authoritative; FUN_1172eac0 (stage->max) and FUN_1172eb20 (stage->unlock text) read shared config, so the server must enforce the same per-stage caps.
functions.notes: class name NPCORG_VO_CLASS_NAME. Global DAT_123bb9a4 is written here and read in FUN_107f0840 (line 261) as the selected-org filter.

functions.purpose: '_getMailInBoxData' handler. Reads the player's mailbox object (ctx+0x2ac4) and builds a MailDataArr of MAIL_DATA_VO_CLASSNAME rows plus allMailNum, for the inbox list UI.
formulas: mailbox object = *(playerCtx + 0x2ac4); skipped if null
allMailNum = mailboxObj[0x20]  (total mail count)

per-mail struct m: _strID = _i64toa(*(int64*)m, base10) (64-bit mail id as string); _nType = *(byte)(m+9); _nSource = *(byte)(m+8); _nRemainTime = m[4] (64-bit via FUN_104d1440); _bHasAccessories = (m[5] != 0xffffffff); _nItemID = m[0x21] (64-bit); _nItemCnt = *(byte)(m+0x88 i.e. m+0x22 dword)
_strItemIconPathName = *(FUN_10254130(m[0x21]) + 0xb4)  (item icon from item-def by id) if item exists
costs: _nItemID / _nItemCnt = single attachment item id + count summarised per mail row
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder; the mailbox contents, counts and expiry timers are server-authoritative (delivered via network into ctx+0x2ac4).
functions.notes: class names MAIL_INBOX_DATA_CLASSNAME / MAIL_DATA_VO_CLASSNAME. Fields: _strID,_bRead,_nType,_nSource,_strTitle,_strSender,_nRemainTime,_bHasAccessories,_nItemID,_nItemCnt,_strItemIconPathName. CPet::SetName reused as a generic string setter.

functions.purpose: 'GetFriendNameData' handler. Reads the friend-list manager (ctx+0x2d5c), builds a FriendNameList VO of friend display names (with an optional name filter), used to populate the mail recipient / friend selector. Emits an 'addtime' boolean per friend derived from how long ago the friendship was formed.
formulas: friend manager = *(playerCtx + 0x2d5c); skipped if null
name filter built from param_4[8] string; friends whose name doesn't match (FUN_10254970 != -1) are skipped
addtime flag: nowSecs = FUN_111f8d20() (current time, 64-bit); friendAddTime = *(friend + 0xc0); addtime = ( (nowSecs - friendAddTime) < 0x3f481 ) ? 0 : 1
0x3f481 = 259201 (= 3*86400 + 1). So addtime=1 means the friendship is OLDER than 3 days; addtime=0 within the first 3 days
costs: 3-day (259200s) threshold gates the 'addtime' friend-maturity flag — likely used to restrict gifting/intimacy actions to friendships older than 3 days
functions.serverRelevance: validation/client-preview. Friend add-time and the social graph are server-authoritative; the 3-day maturity rule should be re-checked server-side for any action it gates. Name matching is client-side filtering only.
functions.notes: class name FRIEND_NAME_CLASS_NAME. friend struct offset +0xc0 = friendship-established timestamp (unix seconds).

functions.purpose: '_refreshMailDetail' handler. For an opened mail it builds the mailReaderData VO: attachment item list (itemList of MAIL_EXTRACT_ITEM_DATA_CLASSNAME), attached currencies (gold/bound-gold/credit with their extract indices), and sender/title/content strings.
formulas: reader source object = *(playerCtx + 0x2ac4) (mailbox); matched mail m selected by 64-bit id (iRam00000078/iRam0000007c)
attachment items iterated over m[0x29]..m[0x2a], stride 0x20 bytes; count = (m[0x2a]-m[0x29]) >> 5
per item at (base+i*0x20): _ullItemId/_itemID = *(base+0x14) (64-bit), _count = *(u16)(base+0x10), _index = *(u16)(base+2); _itemIconPathName/_strItemName from item-def FUN_10254130(itemId)+0xb4
gold = m[0x23]; goldIndex = m[0x24]; credit = m[0x25]; creditIndex = m[0x26]; boundGold = m[0x27]; boundGoldIndex = m[0x28] (all 64-bit via FUN_104d1440)
source = (char)m[2]; strSender = m[0xb]; strTitle = m[0x17]; strContent = m[0x1d]; nMailID via FUN_104d14d0
costs: Mail attachment currencies: gold (m[0x23]), bound gold (m[0x27]), credit (m[0x25]) each with a paired extract-slot index (goldIndex/boundGoldIndex/creditIndex)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder; attachment contents (item ids/counts, gold/bound-gold/credit amounts, expiry, indices) are server-authoritative. ExtractItem/GroupExtractItem (separate handlers) perform the authoritative claim keyed by these indices.
functions.notes: class names MAIL_READER_DATA_CLASSNAME / MAIL_EXTRACT_ITEM_DATA_CLASSNAME. The separate goldIndex/boundGoldIndex/creditIndex fields are extract slot ids the server uses to prevent double-claim.

functions.purpose: Fires a friend online/offline reminder toast if the 'g_FriendRemind' cvar is enabled. Sends UI event 0xc30 when the friend is online (*(friend+0x20)==0) or 0xc31 otherwise.
formulas: gate: cvar 'g_FriendRemind' (via console mgr +0x54, then +0x8 get-value) must be non-zero
if *(friend+0x20)==0 -> FUN_1112f070(0xc30, name)  else -> FUN_1112f070(0xc31, name)
friend display arg = FUN_1024e9b0(friend, 6)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only UI toast. Online-state changes are pushed by the server; this only renders the notification.

functions.purpose: '_getFriendListData' handler. Reads the friend manager (ctx+0x2d5c) and builds the complete friend-list UI model: group headers (GROUP_CLASS_NAME), the default friend list, and per-group friend rows (FRIEND_CLASS_NAME) with identity, server, level, intimacy, online/team/guild info. Cross-server flag derived by comparing each friend's world-server id against the local player's.
formulas: friend manager = *(playerCtx + 0x2d5c); skipped if null
isInTown top field = default true, overridden by (*(*(ctx+0xd0))+0x164)() query

per-friend struct f offsets (dword indexed): netId = f[10]; worldServerId = f[0x11]; HRLevel = f[0x10] and f[0xb] (level fields); intimate = f[0x12] (64-bit via FUN_104d1440 -> intimacy points); isOnline = *(byte)(f+0xe*4); lineID = f[0xf]; strMood = f[0x1a]; nTeamID = f[0x22]; strHunterStar = f[0x29]; StrServer via FUN_1025b060(f[0xd]) when f[0xd]!=0
bCrossServer = ( *(curPlayerCtx + 0x2d78) != friend.worldServerId )  -> local world-server id at ctx+0x2d78
groupType/groupId from f[0x21] sub-record: groupId = *(byte)(f[0x21]+1) when f[0x21]!=0 else 0/0xff
guildName / clanName resolved via FUN_10829c60 (string lookups)
friends grouped: records with f[0x21]==0 go to defaultFriendList; others matched into groupDataList by group id byte *(f[0x21]+1)
costs: intimate = f[0x12] friendship intimacy points (64-bit); HRLevel = hunter rank/level; both server-owned
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder. Entire social graph (membership, intimacy, online state, team/guild association, cross-server ids) is server-authoritative and pushed into ctx+0x2d5c. bCrossServer is a local comparison against ctx+0x2d78 (local world-server id).
functions.notes: class names GROUP_CLASS_NAME, FRIEND_CLASS_NAME. Fields: netId, worldServerId, bCrossServer, StrServer, HRLevel, intimate, groupType, groupId, isOnline, strMood, lineID, guildName, nTeamID, strHunterStar, clanName, groupDataList, defaultFriendList, isInTown. Three friend-emit passes (group friends / default list / per-group cross-ref) share the same field layout.
